name: Supertonic 3
purpose: Lightweight on-device TTS that runs with ONNX Runtime without a cloud call; version 3 expands the open-weight release from 5 to 31 languages, reduces repeat/skip failures and adds expression tags like <laugh> (card).

weaknesses: fixed preset voices in the open package; custom voices only in a demo
soft.maturity: Supertone; v3 successor of an open v1/v2 line.

tona_fit.reason: German in a 0.4 GB ONNX package is attractive for a CPU-side readout voice, but OpenRAIL-M restrictions and preset-only voices make it a comparison point next to Kokoro and Kitten TTS rather than an offer until quality is listened to.
